name: Supertex Industries Limited
about: Supertex Industries Limited engages in the manufacturing of draw warped and sized yarn beams of polyester and nylon in India and internationally. The company offers polyester texturized and nylon crimp yarn; FDY beams for use in sizing and draw warping machines; and bi-shrinkage beams, lycra beams, and nylon beams. It is also involved in processing nylon filament yarn; manufacturing sized beams for weaving; and trade of finished yarns. In addition, the company exports its products. Supertex Industries Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
